keywords: Partition action concerning parcels of land which are a portion of a larger parcel of land. Court varied the District Court judgement, finding that both plaintiff and 4th defendant derived title through the same source and each were entitled to equal shares. The 6th defendant established prescriptive title only to building No. 65. The 2nd and 3rd defendants were entitled to lots No. 73 and No. 75 within the corpus. The 4th defendant\'s appeal was allowed; the 6th and 7th defendants\' appeals were dismissed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Partition Law; Prescription Ordinance
